questions.chapter: Chapter 1: Water Demand Estimation & Population Forecasting Methods
questions.text: Explain Objectives of Water Supply Systems. Explain water-borne diseases (Cholera, Typhoid, Dysentery) and their prevention methods.

questions.chapter: Chapter 2: Sources of Water & River/Reservoir Intake Structures
questions.text: Explain Water Demand types: Domestic, Commercial, Industrial, Public, and Fire Demand (National Building Code / Kuichling's formula $Q = 3182 \sqrt{P}$). Explain Population Forecasting Methods: Arithmetical Increase, Geometrical Increase, Incremental Increase, and Decreasing Growth Rate methods with numerical calculation.

questions.chapter: Chapter 3: Water Quality Standards & Physical/Chemical Parameters
questions.text: Explain Sources of Water: Surface sources vs Ground sources. Explain Groundwater flow: Darcy's law, Dupuit's assumptions, and derive Thiem's formula for steady radial flow to a well in an unconfined aquifer: $Q = \frac{\pi k (H^2 - h_w^2)}{2.303 \log_{10}(R/r_w)}$.

Explain Water Quality Standards (WHO and National Drinking Water Quality Standards of Nepal - NDWQS). Explain physical, chemical, and biological water quality parameters (Turbidity, pH, Hardness, Coliform index, MPN test).

Explain Water Treatment Processes: Plain Sedimentation, Coagulation and Flocculation (Alum dosing, Jar Test), Rapid Sand Filter vs Slow Sand Filter (construction, working, and backwashing mechanism), and Disinfection of water (Chlorination: Breakpoint chlorination curve).

questions.chapter: Chapter 5: Conveyance of Water & Distribution System Layouts
questions.text: Explain Water Distribution Systems: Dead End (Tree), Grid Iron, Ring, and Radial systems. Design balancing capacity of an Elevated Service Reservoir (ESR) using Mass Curve Method.
